items.title: Pay invoice for Akku-Heckenschere
items.quote: Zahlungsziel: 7 Tage nach Rechnungsdatum, netto ohne Abzug.
items.computation: Invoice date (Rechnungsdatum) is 17.12.2025 (Wednesday); this is the triggering event, so under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day itself is not counted. The 7-day period starts on 18.12.2025 (day 1) and runs 18,19,20,21,22,23,24 December = day 7 on 24.12.2025 (Wednesday), per § 188 Abs. 1 BGB. This is a private payment deadline owed to a company, so the relevant weekend/holiday check (§ 193 BGB) uses the payer's own Land (NRW). 24.12.2025 is a Wednesday and a normal working day in NRW (24 Dec is not a public holiday), so no adjustment is needed. Due date: 24.12.2025.
